description: Use this when the user asks to compare, contrast or choose between two to four named perfumes, fragrances or colognes (synonyms: versus, vs, difference between, which one). Returns the perfumes side by side on house, Scento family, top, heart and base notes, shared materials, character, seasons, hours, year and concentration, with scento.com links in the user's language. Don't use to find new perfumes (scent-neighbours or perfume-search) or to explain a single perfume (perfume-portrait).

lang.description: Language of the scento.com links and labels; answers stay in English. Use the language the user writes in, for example "de" (German), "fr" (French), "es" (Spanish) or "it" (Italian). Default "en".

perfumes.description: Two to four perfumes to compare, by name (with house if needed) or slug. Examples: ["Mojave Ghost", "Santal 33"] or ["Oud Wood", "Layton", "Grand Soir"].

name: perfume-contrast
title: Compare perfumes side by side
